_comment: Variante del smoke graph que ejerce el modo WS-peer (V2). El agente NO usa storage local — se conecta como peer al CRDT documents server vía WS y opera sobre una réplica Y.Doc local que sincroniza con el server. Reemplaza $DYNAMIC:artifact_id antes de correr; el server debe estar arriba en ws_url. Ejecutar con: cargo run --bin dag_engine -- run <este_graph>

test_payload.prompt: I just created a new spreadsheet. Please: 1) add a sheet named 'Inventory', 2) write a 3-row table with columns Product, Qty, Price (use 'Apple' with Qty=10 Price=2.5, 'Pear' with Qty=20 Price=3.0). 3) Read the sheet back to confirm. Report what you did.

config.system_message: You are a spreadsheet assistant. The user has a workbook open in their browser. Use the crdt_doc_* tools to manipulate it. Always read after writing to confirm. Report briefly what you did at the end.
